TABLE.NAME: auth_magiclink_token
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores hashed magic link login tokens.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the user who requested the login link.

FIELD.NAME: tokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: A one-way hash of the login token (raw token is never stored, only its hash).

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: The time the login link was requested.

FIELD.NAME: expires
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when this token stops being valid.

FIELD.NAME: consumed
FIELD.COMMENT: Single-use flag, set to 1 once the token has been used to log in.

FIELD.NAME: requestip
FIELD.COMMENT: IP address that requested the link, for audit only (not used to restrict where the link can be used from).
